person_note: The controlling narration is third person. The strongest Goodreads passages sustain external narration of Puller and Bobby while first- and second-person forms occur in dialogue, clipped material, or generic maxims; short he/she/they sentences are left unmarked rather than inheriting the book label. The authorized MS NOW excerpt independently sustains third-person narration in Chapter 1, and BingeBooks continues the same opening through Chapters 2 and 3 rather than providing separate interior coverage. The Goodreads reader's whole-book POV claim is Tier D discovery material, not credible independent evidence. No usable source indicates sustained first- or second-person sections. Confidence is med because the web evidence is opening-only and overlapping, despite diagnostic interior Goodreads corroboration. Audit: independent review retained THIRD, downgraded high to med, corrected the reader review from Tier C/THIRD to Tier D/none, documented the overlapping opening, and changed q02141, q02148, and q02159 from third to unmarked.
